Pathways: Life & Work.passage: In the project 'Life in a Day', people from all over the world recorded their normal lives. Some stories were typical, like eating breakfast. But others were extraordinary. These videos connect people and help them communicate their unique experiences. It shows that even a banal day can contribute to a large global project.

questions.q: What is the project 'Life in a Day' about?
How do these videos help people?

Pathways: Life & Work.passage: When you apply for a job, you must be enthusiastic. Managers want a candidate who is responsible for their work. During the training, you will learn new skills and how to use modern equipment. Experience is important, but a positive attitude is often more valuable.

What will you learn during training?
